description: R08 Host Clipboard checkpoint: safe Rust TextBuffer ownership now reproduces Microsoft's block- and line-selection CopyRequest/GetPlainText extraction contracts, including wide glyphs, trailing whitespace, forced wraps and CRLF boundaries.

entries.notes: Rust preserves the first 15 selected columns on every physical row, including six trailing spaces and wide Japanese glyphs, and inserts CRLF between each block-selection row.
Rust trims trailing whitespace and emits CRLF only on non-wrapped rows while retaining complete width on forced-wrap rows and clipping the final selected row to 15 columns.
